featured_reviews.review_text: Mismanaged & poor customer service. They need to improve on customer service by leaps & bounds, training of staff. Whenever you order medicines the person who picks up takes the order (sometimes multiple people will come on the phone asking you the repeat the same order, so you end up telling 3 different people the same thing) does not end up communicating it & delivering the order (mostly because they forgot & then they make up a lie saying that the medicine was not there or the delivery boy was not there). In addition, they lack basic etiquette of following through on an order the next day (if they say that they do not have it when you ask them & will deliver it the next day), they just do not send the medicine at all (and these guys are in a critical customer service sector where you cannot afford to ignore a patient's need. You are not selling stationary or basic grocery, you are selling medicines and medical needs). Also if you happen to buy a product from them that the doctor tells changes and you want to return it, Rachit does not give you the money back and tells you to buy other medicines to make up for it (which is okay) but at least calculate properly and do not eat up part of the money by saying that the customer has exhausted the funds of that product (the customer also keeps a track and calculates on their end how many purchases he/she has made & how much money is still pending. They are not dumb). Rachit especially and 1 or 2 of the staff from the store seem to have temper issues and at times are arrogant and argue and yell at the customer (patient) back unnecessarily & neither are their delivery boys taught manners or given a heads-up on how much the charge the customer or whether the customer has already paid etc. These days its become highly annoying dealing with this store. Whoever handled it previously some years back handled the store well. Its like calling for your medicines or calling for unnecessary stress and headache. I have written this review after trying to be patient and letting go many times & not because I have any personal grudges against anyone from this store. I’m truly fed-up now with this store and the way they behave.

featured_reviews.name: Ahmed Ahmed
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you're still paying premium prices for branded medicines, it's time to rethink—and Zeelab Pharmacy is the perfect place to start. Their range of generic medicines offers the same salt, same dosage, and same effectiveness as branded drugs, all approved by the CENTRAL DRUG STANDARD CONTROL ORGANIZATION (CDSCO), India’s top regulatory authority for pharmaceuticals.

So why the price difference?
It’s not about quality—it’s about branding. Big-name companies charge more due to their brand value and marketing costs. Zeelab cuts through that noise and delivers affordable healthcare without compromising safety or efficacy.

Don’t fear generic medicine.
It’s time to change the mentality that cheap means risky. Generic medicines are scientifically equivalent and legally approved. By choosing Zeelab, you’re choosing smart healthcare—protecting your health and your wallet.

Spread the word. Let’s normalize generic medicine and make healthcare truly accessible for all.
